title: 1 · The five tones
blurb: Hear and say Thai's five tones, and read the tone marks in the romanization under every Thai word.

title: 2 · Sounds: aspiration, long and short vowels
blurb: Tell apart the Thai sounds English mixes up: a puff of air or none, a long vowel or a short one, and final sounds that are held.

title: 3 · Hello, thank you, sorry: ครับ and ค่ะ
blurb: Say hello, thank you, sorry and it's OK politely, with the right ending for how you want to be heard.

title: 4 · Numbers and money
blurb: Count to a million, read a price tag aloud in Thai, and ask how much something costs.

title: 5 · Consonants and the three classes
blurb: Recognize about 30 common Thai consonants, name them, and know which of the three classes each belongs to.

title: 6 · Vowels and where they sit
blurb: Find the vowel in a Thai syllable wherever it is written, and read it long or short.

title: 7 · Pronouns and polite particles
blurb: Say I, you, he and we the Thai way, drop them when they are clear, and put the owner after the noun: my friend, my sister.

title: 8 · Final consonants: live and dead syllables
blurb: Read the end of a Thai syllable, tell live syllables from dead ones, and work out the tone of any word without a tone mark.

title: 9 · เป็น, คือ, อยู่: is, and is at
blurb: Say what someone is, what something is, and where it is, and know when Thai needs no word for is at all.

title: 10 · Classifiers: counting things
blurb: Count people, animals and things the Thai way: noun, number, classifier.

title: 11 · Tone marks and the tone rules
blurb: Read the tone of any word with a tone mark, using the consonant class and the tone chart.

title: 12 · นี้, นั้น, ของ: this, that and whose
blurb: Point at things with this and that, and say whose they are.

title: 13 · ไม่ and ไหม: not, and yes/no questions
blurb: Say what you don't like, ask yes/no questions, and answer them the Thai way.

title: 14 · Clusters and leading consonants
blurb: Read two consonants that start one syllable, a silent ห or อ in front, and the vowel Thai does not write.

title: 15 · Question words stay in place
blurb: Ask what, who, where, how much and how many without moving a single word.

title: 16 · Special spellings and reading sentences
blurb: Read silent letters, the common irregular words, ๆ and ฯ, and a menu line with no spaces.

title: 17 · Ordering food and drink
blurb: Order dishes and drinks, say how spicy you want them, call the server and pay.

title: 18 · Family and jobs
blurb: Talk about your family, brothers and sisters by age, what people do and how old they are.

title: 19 · Describing and comparing: กว่า, ที่สุด
blurb: Describe things in the right order and compare them: bigger, the biggest, the same.

title: 20 · Telling time and daily routine
blurb: Tell the time the Thai way, name the days of the week, and say when you do things every day.

title: 21 · Time words: แล้ว, กำลัง, จะ
blurb: Say what happened, what is happening and what will happen, with verbs that never change.

title: 22 · ได้ and อยาก: can and want
blurb: Say what you want, what you can and can't do, and what you have to do, and ask "can you …?".

title: 23 · Asking politely: ขอ, ช่วย, หน่อย
blurb: Ask for things and ask people to do things politely, and say "don't" and "go ahead".

title: 24 · Directions, places and transport
blurb: Ask where places are, follow simple directions, and tell a taxi driver where to go and where to stop.

title: 25 · Shopping: clothes and colors
blurb: Ask prices, bargain politely, try clothes on, name colors and pay, with each item's classifier.

title: 26 · Feelings and health
blurb: Say how you feel, say what hurts and that you are sick, and get help at a pharmacy.
